name: gnome-software
description: No self-update; delegates to PackageKit — preserves distro signature model. (Flatpak keyless remotes degrade to TLS-only.)
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Targeted retained-source read supports the narrow package-manager behavior: Flatpak backend enables GPG verification and installs a configured remote key when present, but explicitly disables GPG verification when the remote has no key; package verification is delegated to backend configuration.
limitations: This application delegates payload verification to PackageKit/Flatpak/snapd/apt backends; the external backend version and active keyring are outside this checkout.
This evidence does not establish a complete primary self-updater classification.
